config.control_description: Plasticity off uses the same seed and exploration stream. Shuffled reward uses the on-policy run's training utility multiset, permuted offline and delivered in note order during a separate run. Frozen evaluation disables exploration and plasticity in all conditions.

limitations: One fixed, evenly spaced synthetic lane-one map is used for both phases.
Training hit rates include exploratory motor stimulation and are descriptive only.
The shuffled control uses an offline on-policy reward multiset; its reward sequence is not causal feedback from its own performance.
Non-MISS hits include early OK; precision and transfer must be assessed separately.
